verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic-search runtime, and such a product could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to. The MCP server and the LangChain and Vercel AI SDK integrations let users' own external assistants and agents call Moss. That is the reverse role (Moss as a tool, not a built-in assistant), so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
